profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Metrea Strategic Insights
profile.summary:
IT project lead and software engineer with extensive software development experience in both independent and leadership roles. Highly proficient in systems design, implementation, and integration. Full stack developer with full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) experience. Expert in Relational Databases and User Interface (UI) design.

IT Project Lead/Manager
Solution-focused IT project lead/manager in leading large-scale technology projects from design to implementation. Instrumental in dissecting complex problems, devising iterative processes, and leading end-to-end change management.
* Ensure the organization’s strategic plans and values are communicated to the team, and integrated into the team’s objectives, deliverables and services.
* Define scope, goals, and deliverables for software projects in collaboration with senior management and stakeholder to develop full-scale project plans and associated communication documents.
* Direct and manage software projects utilizing SDLC methodologies.
* Identify and communicate project objectives to the team and distribute tasks based on the employee's skill level and professional specialization.
* Lead the team to identify, distribute and balance workloads with established priorities to ensure the timely accomplishment of milestones.

Software Engineer Lead
Highly skilled IT professional with 23 years of experience in system/application development. Critical skills on the enterprise level for database design and modeling business logic in architecture design.
* Understand customer needs and help customers to visualize the business logic and workflow with user-friendly UI with advanced technology and methodology.
* Self-initiate tasks. Determine and pursue courses of action necessary to obtain desired results proactively.
* Serve as team spokesperson on advanced projects and programs. Act as advisor to management and customers on advanced technical research studies and applications.
* Develop advanced technological ideas to guide team members’ development into a final product to meet customers’ needs.
* Work on complex technical problems and provide innovative and ingenious

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implementing Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-based solutions to develop scalable, high-performance applications. Collaborating across development teams while driving DevOps automation and front-end innovation.
•	Established and maintained Azure DevOps infrastructure to streamline development workflows and support ongoing toolchain scalability.
•	Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines, accelerating delivery and reducing manual release overhead.
•	Containerized the application using Docker and deployed it via Azure Container Apps for resilient, cloud-native scaling.
•	Architected and implemented a scalable Azure PostgreSQL back-end; designed new schemas and optimized performance for multi-user workloads.
•	Integrated Azure Active Directory for secure authentication across the platform.
•	Developed a responsive React-based front-end aligned with stakeholder wireframes and iterative user feedback.
•	Redesigned and deployed company website using WordPress and JavaScript, enhancing brand visibility.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Node.js · PostgreSQL · MS SQL · REST APIs · Azure DevOps Services · Git/Bit Bucket · JavaScript · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Figma (Software) · WordPress · docker

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Led large-scale technology projects, mentored junior developers, and directed implementation of enterprise-level solutions in Agile environments.
•	Delivered enterprise-wide UIS Portal serving 3,000+ users; integrated 12,500 NAS sites and 57,000 assets into an inventory system.
•	Engineered system alignment with FAA’s Facility, System, and Equipment Profile (FSEP) database to ensure traceability and compliance.
•	Integrated SSO authentication via SiteMinder and Azure Active Directory for secure access.
•	Developed the Workplace Inspection Tool (WIT), supporting 11,000+ inspections annually.
•	Built the Training Needs Assessment Tool (TNAT), streamlining workforce readiness for 7,100+ FAA managers.
•	Created complementary modules for funding, scheduling, and training collaboration.
•	Managed Jira-based Agile delivery cycles and served as technical lead for Facilities Asset Inventory (FAI) system.

projects.title: UIS Portal / Asset Database
projects.description: This system is utilized to capture and retrieve high level information on the roughly 12,500 National airspace System (NAS) sites in the Unstaffed Infrastructure Sustainment (UIS) inventory. For example, via this application, you can access the age, see, composition, subjective condition, and other information on every unstaffed building in the NAS. Similar information is available for each radio tower, HVAC unit, road, fence, and certain other assets in the UIS inventory.

projects.title: Training Needs Assessment Tool
projects.description: The major purpose of the EOSH TNAT is to provide FAA managers with a a web-based software application that provides a standard method of identifying the EOSH training needs of their employees through a series of questions about the empties' job tasks.
